title: Input

chain_ids.title: Chain Ids
chain_ids.description: Comma-separated chain IDs to include in the affinity calculation. At least one valid chain ID is required. Example: 'A,B'.

input_structure.title: Input Structure
input_structure.description: TOS URI to the input protein structure in PDB or mmCIF format. The model uses this structure to compute binding affinity scores.

custom_output_path.title: Custom Output Path
custom_output_path.description: Resolved output destination. Set by framework — see gateway.source.ApiSource.resolve_output_dest().

notes: Schema accepts NO mutation list and NO per-residue or per-chain restriction: the scan is exhaustive over all mutable positions of the supplied chains.

Consequence: the submitted job inevitably returns both chains A and B (4674 rows = 246 residues x 19 substitutions); the full table is retained as raw output and only chain-B rows are treated as candidates.
Schema documents no direction, no unit, and no score scale for the output ddG_pred column.
